title: Reimplement Kurbo-Backed Geometry Types First-Party
description: Replace semio-framework-geometry's kurbo-backed Point, Vec2, Affine, Rect, RoundedRectRadii, RoundedRect, Circle, Line, Arc, CubicBez, and BezPath storage and production behavior with first-party Rust value types and algorithms. Inventory all repository consumers first. Preserve kurbo only as a dev-dependency oracle, add deterministic differential tests including tolerance-sensitive Shape path generation, verify native/browser/wasm32-wasip2 consumers, and prove kurbo is absent from shipped plugin dependency graphs.
